snippet.title: Job Fit For a Devil - Official Announcement Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Job Fit For a Devil, an adventure exploration crafting game developed by Baba Yaga Games. Players will dedicate their service to Peter the Great as a devil who sets out to trick, lie, steal, and cheat to climb the ladder and please Peter the Great. Job Fit For a Devil is coming soon to PC (Steam).
